iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.description: Raw ore from the hills. Smelt it at a furnace.

log.name: Log
log.description: Felled timber. Saw it into planks at a workbench.

sapling.name: Sapling
sapling.description: Plant it on a stump to grow a new tree.

handle.name: Handle
handle.description: A grip for tools and weapons.

wool.name: Wool
wool.description: Sheared from sheep. Tailors spin and weave it.

hide.name: Hide
hide.description: From a hunted deer. Leatherworkers tan it.

herb.name: Herb
herb.description: A medicinal plant. Apothecaries brew with it.

string.name: String
string.description: Spun wool. Bowstrings, stitching and lacing.

leather_strap.name: Leather Strap
leather_strap.description: Straps for armor, shields and mechanisms.

cogwheel.name: Cogwheel
cogwheel.description: A small iron gear for mechanisms.

healing_salve.name: Healing Salve
healing_salve.description: Click it in your bag to heal 25 health.

cloth_robe.name: Cloth Robe
cloth_robe.description: Light, comfortable, and favored by healers.

wooden_bow.name: Wooden Bow
wooden_bow.description: A plank bow with a tailor's string.

spike_trap.name: Spike Trap
spike_trap.description: Click it in your bag to set it where you stand. The first invader to step on it takes 15 damage.

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.description: Shot from a bow. Missed arrows land on the ground; pick them up with E.
